facts.big: That’s great news! · I’m happy for you
facts.label: Mostrar emoção
facts.sub: Reaja: That’s great news! Mostre alegria: I’m so happy for you. Orgulho: proud of. Entusiasmo: excited about.

facts.label: Que ótima notícia!
facts.sub: Use That’s great news! para reagir a uma boa notícia. News é incontável: não diga a news nem two news. Combina bem com I’m so happy for you e Congrats.

facts.label: Feliz por você
facts.sub: Use I’m so happy for you para mostrar que você sente alegria pelo sucesso do outro. Use for, não of. Também funciona: I’m really glad to hear that.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “I’m happy for you” is a warm reaction.
We say “I am happy of you”.

group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “I’m happy for you” is a warm reaction. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I am happy of you”. → Falso (We say happy for you.)
“I’m proud of you” is natural. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Good news in Miami · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright afternoon in Miami, and the ocean is blue. Cleo runs along the street with her phone in her hand. She has a job offer from a design studio. It is a big success for her young career. Zoe waits for her at a small table near the beach. Cleo is too happy to keep the achievement a secret.
“Guess what? I got the job at the design studio!” says Cleo. “That’s great news, Cleo! I’m so happy for you.” says Zoe. “Thank you! I was afraid they wouldn’t choose me.” says Cleo.
